question: Zonal Councils were created under the ______ Act, 1956.
solution:
The correct answer is __**States Reorganisation Act, 1956**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Zonal Councils** were established under the **States Reorganisation Act, 1956**. These councils were created to promote cooperation and coordination between states and union territories.
 
• The Act divided India into five zones: **Central, Northern, Southern, Eastern, and Western**. Each zone has its own Zonal Council, which is chaired by the Union Home Minister.
 
• The Zonal Councils aim to address common issues such as **economic development, border disputes, linguistic matters, and infrastructure planning** within the states of each zone.
 
• **Key Features:** These councils are advisory bodies and do not have legislative powers. They help ensure cooperative federalism and promote inter-state harmony.
